mentions.note: 17th in 1913 South of Thames Junior race (Belgrave third team); gave the club's Half-Mile Championship cup

photos.c: PHOTOGRAPH OPPOSITE---1913 South of Thames "Junior" winners. Left to Right:- Dick Best (17th), Joe Helm (9th), Harry Parker (15th), Ernie Musselbrook (18th) and Oscar Horwood (16th).
